comment: P889 — worker-pool sizing: hostProfile is 'dedicated' (default; the server owns the box) or 'shared' (a game client/bot driver shares it, as in single-player skirmish). expectedPlayers defaults to the configured capacity (teams x maxPlayersPerTeam); set it to the real count on a small server, e.g. 20. ALLEGIANCE_HOST_PROFILE / ALLEGIANCE_EXPECTED_PLAYERS override these. See docs/PERFORMANCE.md, 'Running on your own hardware'.
